# Verifiable Services with VS Agent

VS Agent is the agent runtime that turns a service or an AI agent into a Verifiable Service: it holds the DID and the credentials, speaks DIDComm and OpenID4VC, resolves trust, and operates on the registry on behalf of your corporation.

The guides below are being written against VS Agent 2.0 and the v4 testnet. Pages marked legacy come from the previous documentation and describe the v1 API.
